body:
Files ticket 0004. Observed on 2026-09-23: a wrong caller-supplied `--title` produced a misnamed PDF (Stern 2004, *World Development*, saved as `Stern_2004_Development_Discounting_Climate_Change.pdf`), which then went into Zotero under that name. DOIfetch trusts `--title` and otherwise names the file `Unknown_<doi>`.

The ticket proposes naming files from Crossref metadata and logging a warning when a supplied title does not match. Ticket file only; `erg check` passes. Its one warning is an unrelated `AGENTS.md` version stamp.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
